PFMS Maker Pages: Before and After

Before is main (localhost:3007); after is feat/e-anudaan-pfms-maker (localhost:3036). Same demo Maker, same seed data, 1440 wide, full page. Captured 4 Oct 2026.

Maker's home page

Before: “Payment Reports”: six report tabs, coloured tiles. After: “Dashboard”: where the files are, in five plain groups, with exceptions and Bureau holds below.

Payment Advices list

Before: Six tabs to look through. After: One list; a Case column says what each file needs.

Payment advice

Before: Five-step wizard, one step per screen. After: One page, five numbered sections, with tables for heads and documents.

Payment Status — in progress

Before: Breadcrumb, sanction card, requests, instalments. After: Six plain stages, reconciliation, bill, payment history.

Payment Status — stopped

Before: Failed stage drawn as an ordinary current stage. After: Failed stage in red, the reason, and a single next step.
